title: Read a path input
summary: ASP.NET Core: Read a path input. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: Curly braces name a route value. Open GET /hello/Ravi. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read a path input with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Read a path input

blocks.text: Route binding supplies Ravi to the string input. The interpolated string uses that value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not place user text into raw HTML without escaping it.
